statements.t: The webcast will take place on Thursday, August 13, 2026, at 8:30 AM and will be accessible in the investor relations section of the Company’s website at luciddx.com .
Following the conclusion of the conference call, a replay will be available for 30 days on the investor relations section of the Company’s website at luciddx.com .

risks.t: among other things, volatility in the price of Lucid Diagnostics’ common stock
the uncertainties inherent in research and development, including the cost and time required to advance Lucid Diagnostics’ products to regulatory submission
whether regulatory authorities will be satisfied with the design of and results from Lucid Diagnostics’ clinical and preclinical studies
whether and when Lucid Diagnostics’ products are cleared by regulatory authorities
market acceptance of Lucid Diagnostics’ products once cleared and commercialized
Lucid Diagnostics’ ability to raise additional funding as needed
